section_summary.extract_value: The Results note that sample characteristics are described in Table 1. Male and female groups differed on body image dissatisfaction (DIF = 1.678; t(345) = 4.31; p < .05), with girls wanting to be thinner; BAS scores showed no statistical sex difference (p > .05). No further sample details (e.g., sample size, age, BMI, country), survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported in the provided text.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The sample characteristics are described in Table 1. The male and female groups were statistically different for body image dissatisfaction, (DIF = 1.678; t(345) =  4.31; p <.05), and the girls wanted to be thinner with regard to boys. For BAS scores, there was no statistical difference between the sexes (p > .05)."
